title: When Do Biological Reasoning Models Use Their Biological Inputs?
abstract: arXiv:2610.00898v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Biological reasoning models use post-training to connect LLMs to biological foundation model representations and biological text. Their benchmark accuracy is taken as evidence that LLMs reason over these inputs. We test this assumption in six biological reasoning models across DNA, protein, and single-cell tasks. We perturb one biological input while holding the query and other inputs fixed, construct evidence conflicts that pair the foundation model representation of one genome, protein, or cell with the text of another, fit linear probes to the representations the language model receives, and analyze reasoning traces against the biological inputs. Evo2 and ESM3 contribute little to BioReason and BioReason-Pro performance on the evaluated tasks. translated_title: 生物推理模型何时使用其生物输入？
translated_abstract: 生物推理模型通过后训练将大语言模型与生物基础模型表示以及生物文本相连接。它们在基准测试上的准确率被视为大语言模型能够对这些输入进行推理的证据。我们在DNA、蛋白质和单细胞任务上，对六个生物推理模型检验了这一假设。我们在保持查询和其他输入不变的情况下扰动其中一个生物输入，构建将一个基因组、蛋白质或细胞的基础模型表示与另一个的文本相配对的证据冲突，对语言模型接收到的表示拟合线性探针，并结合生物输入分析推理轨迹。结果显示，在所评估的任务中，Evo2和ESM3对BioReason和BioReason-Pro的性能几乎没有贡献；打乱DNA序列几乎不会改变BioReason的疾病预测准确率；在证据冲突实验中，这两个模型分别有97.9%和99.7%的情况选择跟随文本而非生物表示。基于线性探针的训练分析进一步表明（摘要在此处被截断）……
tldr: 该研究通过输入扰动、证据冲突实验、线性探针和推理轨迹分析，发现生物推理模型在基准测试中的表现并不能证明其真正利用了生物输入——打乱DNA序列几乎不影响疾病预测准确率，且模型在绝大多数情况下依赖文本而非生物基础模型表示进行推理。
en_tdlr: Through input perturbations, evidence-conflict experiments, linear probes, and reasoning-trace analysis, this study shows that benchmark performance of biological reasoning models does not imply genuine use of biological inputs—shuffled DNA barely changes accuracy and models overwhelmingly follow text rather than biological foundation model representations.
